options.systemMessage:
You are an AI Lease Generator for a property management company. You collect lease details step by step then output a JSON data object that will be used to fill in the official NSW Fair Trading Standard Form (FT6600, updated 17 December 2025).

You have one tool: search_rental_property.

== STEP 1: PROPERTY SEARCH ==
When the user types an address, extract just the suburb and call search_rental_property.
Examples: '20 Ocean Manly' -> suburb = 'Manly' | '6 Beesand Mango Hill QLD' -> suburb = 'Mango Hill'

The search result is a JSON array. Each item contains:
- price_rent (weekly rent number)
- price_bond (bond number, may be null)
- property.system_search_key (the full address string)
- property.adr_state_or_region (state)
- property.adr_suburb_or_town (suburb)
- property.adr_postcode (postcode)
- property.system_owner_user.name (landlord full name)
- property.system_owner_user.email_address (landlord email address)

Show each property numbered:
1. [property.system_search_key]
   Rent: $[price_rent]/week | Bond: $[calculated bond]
   Landlord: [system_owner_user.name]

Ask the user to pick a number.

== STEP 2: CONFIRM SELECTION ==
Read values from the chosen item. Show confirmation and ask: 'Is this correct? Reply YES or NO.'
If YES go to Step 3. If NO ask for address again.

== STEP 3: COLLECT DETAILS (one question at a time) ==
Q1: What is the tenant full name? (if multiple tenants, list all separated by comma)
Q2: How many occupants maximum?
Q3: Lease start date? (DD/MM/YYYY)
Q4: Fixed Term or Periodic? (reply FIXED or PERIODIC)
Q5: (only if FIXED) Lease end date? (DD/MM/YYYY)
Q6: Rent payment method? (Bank Transfer / Direct Debit / BPAY / Centrepay)
Q7: Are pets allowed? (YES or NO. If YES, what animal?)
Q8: Any additional special conditions? (or type NONE)

== STEP 4: SUMMARY REVIEW ==
After Q8, show a full summary and ask for confirmation:

LEASE SUMMARY - Please review:
Property: [address]
Landlord: [name]
Tenant(s): [names]
Rent: $[amount]/week | Bond: $[amount]
Term: [FIXED from date to date / PERIODIC from date]
Payment: [method]
Pets: [YES - animal / NO]
Special conditions: [conditions or None]

Reply GENERATE to create the lease, or tell me what to change.

== STEP 5: GENERATE LEASE ==
Only after the manager replies GENERATE, say 'Generating your lease now, please wait...' then output the data wrapped EXACTLY as:

%%LEASE_START%%
{JSON object here}
%%LEASE_END%%

The JSON object must have EXACTLY these fields with REAL values (no placeholders):

{
  "agreement_date": "[today DD/MM/YYYY]",

  "landlord_name_1": "[landlord full name from Rex - property.system_owner_user.name]",

Today's date: {{ $now.toFormat('dd/MM/yyyy') }}

After %%LEASE_END%% write: 'Your lease PDF is being prepared and will be sent shortly!'

== CRITICAL RULES ==
- Output ONLY valid JSON between the markers - no extra text inside
- All values must be REAL data from this conversation - never leave placeholder text
- landlord_phone must be a phone number only - if Rex has no phone number use empty string ""
- landlord_email_service must be the actual email address from Rex (email_address field) - never put a name there
- agent_contact must be the actual email address from Rex - never put a name there
- Bond max = 4 weeks rent for NSW; if price_bond is null, calculate as rent x 4
- One question at a time during Steps 1-4
- Never invent data - only use Rex CRM data and what the user typed
- On hello/hi/start/new/restart: say 'Welcome to the AI Lease Generator! Please type the property address to get started.'
- When starting a new lease, ignore all data from previous leases in this conversation.

parameters.toolDescription: Search for a rental property in Rex CRM. IMPORTANT: Rex stores addresses like '17 Ocean, Manly QLD 4179' so you must search using ONLY the suburb name as the keyword. Extract just the suburb from the user's address and pass it as {suburb}. For example if user types '20 Ocean Manly' extract 'Manly' as the suburb. Returns list of properties. Each result has: id (listing id), property_id, price_rent, price_bond, AND a nested 'property' object containing: system_search_key (full address), adr_street_number, adr_street_name, adr_suburb_or_town, adr_state_or_region, adr_postcode, and system_owner_user (with name, email_address = landlord details). Use ALL of this data - do NOT call read_property separately.

parameters.jsCode:
const output = $input.item.json.output;
const start = output.indexOf('%%LEASE_START%%');
const end = output.indexOf('%%LEASE_END%%');
const leaseText = output.substring(start + 15, end).trim();
const lease = JSON.parse(leaseText);

const rentMethod = (lease.rent_method || '').toLowerCase();
const bondPaidTo = (lease.bond_paid_to || '').toLowerCase();

let termRadioValue = 'Periodic';
if (lease.term_type === 'FIXED' && lease.term_start && lease.term_end) {
  const [sd, sm, sy] = lease.term_start.split('/').map(Number);
  const [ed, em, ey] = lease.term_end.split('/').map(Number);
  const months = (ey - sy) * 12 + (em - sm);
  if (months === 6) termRadioValue = '6 months';
  else if (months === 12) termRadioValue = '12 months';
  else if (months === 24) termRadioValue = '2 years';
  else if (months === 36) termRadioValue = '3 years';
  else if (months === 60) termRadioValue = '5 years';
  else termRadioValue = 'Other';
}

const landlordValues = {
  'Agreement date': lease.agreement_date,
  'Agreement location': lease.agreement_place,
  'Landlord name 1': lease.landlord_name_1,
  'Landlord name 2': lease.landlord_name_2 || '',
  'Landlord contact': lease.landlord_phone || '',
  'Landlord overseas state': lease.landlord_state || '',
  'Landlord phone (if not provided)': lease.landlord_no_agent_phone || '',
  'Landlord service address': lease.landlord_no_agent_address || '',
  'Suburb': lease.landlord_no_agent_suburb || '',
  'State': lease.landlord_no_agent_state || '',
  'Postcode': lease.landlord_no_agent_postcode || '',
  'Corporation name': lease.corp_name || '',
  'Corporation business address': lease.corp_address || '',
  'Corporation suburb': lease.corp_suburb || '',
  'Corporation state': lease.corp_state || '',
  'Corporation postcode': lease.corp_postcode || '',
  'Landlord agent name': lease.agent_name || '',
  'Agent service address': lease.agent_address || '',
  'Agent suburb': lease.agent_suburb || '',
  'Agent state': lease.agent_state || '',
  'Agent postcode': lease.agent_postcode || '',
  'Agent contact details': lease.agent_contact || '',
  'Premises address': lease.premises_address || '',
  'Premises inclusions': lease.premises_inclusions || '',
  'Landlord electronic consent': lease.landlord_electronic_consent === 'Yes' ? 'Yes' : 'No',
  'Landlord electronic email': lease.landlord_email_service || '',
  'Landlord name (signature block)': lease.landlord_name_1 || '',
};

const tenantValues = {
  'Tenant name 1': lease.tenant_name_1,
  'Tenant name 2': lease.tenant_name_2 || '',
  'Tenant name 3': lease.tenant_name_3 || '',
  'Other tenants': lease.tenant_other || '',
  'Tenant service address': lease.tenant_address || '',
  'Tenant suburb': lease.tenant_suburb || '',
  'Tenant state': lease.tenant_state || '',
  'Tenant postcode': lease.tenant_postcode || '',
  'Tenant contact details': lease.tenant_contact || '',
  'Tenant agent name': lease.tenant_agent_name || '',
  'Tenant agent address': lease.tenant_agent_address || '',
  'Tenant agent suburb': lease.tenant_agent_suburb || '',
  'Tenant agent state': lease.tenant_agent_state || '',
  'Tenant agent postcode': lease.tenant_agent_postcode || '',
  'Tenant agent contact': lease.tenant_agent_contact || '',
  'Lease term': termRadioValue,
  'Other term description': termRadioValue === 'Other' ? lease.term_end : '',
  'Start date': lease.term_start || '',
  'End date': lease.term_end || '',
  'Rent amount': String(lease.rent_amount || ''),
  'Rent frequency': lease.rent_period === 'week' ? 'weekly' : lease.rent_period === 'fortnight' ? 'fortnightly' : 'other',
  'Other frequency description': !['week','fortnight'].includes(lease.rent_period) ? lease.rent_period : '',
  'Day rent due': lease.rent_day || '',
  'First rent due date': lease.rent_first_due || '',
  'Electronic bank transfer': rentMethod.includes('bank') || rentMethod.includes('bpay') || rentMethod.includes('direct debit'),
  'Centrepay': rentMethod.includes('centrepay'),
  'Other payment method': !rentMethod.includes('bank') && !rentMethod.includes('bpay') && !rentMethod.includes('direct debit') && !rentMethod.includes('centrepay'),
  'Payment method details': lease.rent_method_details || '',
  'Bond amount': String(lease.bond_amount || ''),
  'Bond payment': bondPaidTo.includes('agent') ? "Landlord's agent" : bondPaidTo.includes('fair trading') ? 'NSW Fair Trading' : 'Landlord or other',
  'Maximum occupants': String(lease.max_occupants || ''),
  'Electrical repair contact': lease.electrical_tradesperson || '',
  'Electrical repair phone': lease.electrical_phone || '',
  'Plumbing repair contact': lease.plumbing_tradesperson || '',
  'Plumbing repair phone': lease.plumbing_phone || '',
  'Other repair contact': lease.other_tradesperson || '',
  'Other repair phone': lease.other_phone || '',
  'Water payment': lease.water_usage_tenant_pays === 'Yes' ? 'Yes' : 'No',
  'Electricity embedded': lease.electricity_embedded === 'Yes' ? 'Yes' : 'No',
  'Gas embedded': lease.gas_embedded === 'Yes' ? 'Yes' : 'No',
  'Smoke alarm type': (lease.smoke_alarm_type||'').toLowerCase().includes('hardwired') ? 'Hardwired' : 'Battery operated',
  'Battery replaceable': lease.smoke_alarm_battery_replaceable === 'Yes' ? 'Yes' : 'No',
  'Backup battery replaceable': lease.smoke_alarm_hardwired_backup_replaceable === 'Yes' ? 'Yes' : 'No',
  'Strata applicable': lease.strata_owners_corp_responsible === 'Yes' ? 'Yes' : 'No',
  'Strata by laws': lease.strata_bylaws === 'Yes' ? 'Yes' : 'No',
  'Tenant electronic consent': lease.tenant_electronic_consent === 'Yes' ? 'Yes' : 'No',
  'Tenant electronic email': lease.tenant_email_service || '',
  'Animal consent details': lease.pet_description || '',
  'Additional information': lease.additional_terms || '',
  'Tenant (1) name': lease.tenant_name_1 || '',
  'Tenant (2) name': lease.tenant_name_2 || '',
  'Tenant (3) name': lease.tenant_name_3 || '',
};

const clean = (obj) => Object.fromEntries(
  Object.entries(obj).filter(([k, v]) => v !== '' && v !== null && v !== undefined)
);

return {
  json: {
    landlordValues: clean(landlordValues),
    tenantValues: clean(tenantValues),
    chatId: $('Telegram Trigger').item.json.message.chat.id,
    tenantName: lease.tenant_name_1,
    propertyAddress: lease.premises_address
  }
};
